dataLayerPolicy.dataDirectory: Consumable machine-readable release data and model-facing metadata.
dataLayerPolicy.datasetDirectory: Source acquisition, provenance, permissions, schemas, registries, and research-control records.
dataLayerPolicy.typescriptSources: Canonical detailed application records until all 35 standalone JSON profiles are materialized and validated.
dataLayerPolicy.curatedVsGenerated: Curated reference-media.json and manifest.json must never be overwritten by generated application exports. Generated media and export metadata use separate filenames.

limitations: Six of 35 detailed diagnostic records are now verified as standalone JSON files; 29 still require materialization before the detailed release is complete.
Reference-media entries contain provenance and rights metadata; image binaries are not yet stored as a local model-training corpus.
No current reference image is marked trainingEligible. Scientific composites require panel-level crops, labels, source grouping, and leakage-safe split assignment first.
Copyright-restricted institutional images remain excluded from the public training layer.
External plant-disease datasets are registered only for transfer learning and robustness work; they are not Cannabis ground truth.
GitHub push automation has not yet produced a verifiable generated export commit, so automation is not treated as completed evidence.
